segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: I prefer keeping audio by default so people can check transcription errors.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: I disagree. Audio should be deleted after transcription to reduce retained sensitive data.

segments.speaker: You
segments.text: Both arguments are on the table. We will not settle the default today.

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: I still prefer keeping audio. I do not agree to deletion by default.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: I still prefer deletion. I will prepare a list of the privacy tradeoffs by Tuesday.

segments.speaker: You
segments.text: The only agreement is to review that list next time. There is no agreed audio retention default.
